Tasha (encops): FYI scanner detected a set of DB snapshot objects in the cross-account replica bucket with no SSE-KMS info. Possibly related to the new external-HSM CMEK onboarding.
Miguel (sre): Which bucket/account? sample keys?
Tasha (encops): s3://replica-backups-eu-prod (account: 210987654321). Sample: replica/snap-2026-04-02-11-02.sql.lz4. Found via `aws s3api head-object`.
Arun (db): I see 3 objects from last 12h created by the replication job. `head-object` shows `ServerSideEncryption: null`.
Zoe (infra): We recently changed the replication role to assume a cross-account role in 210987654321. The external HSM-backed key policy in that account may not include the replica role as grantee.
Tasha (encops): Timeline: detection 4765432000, confirmed 4765432055. No public ACLs.
Miguel (sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) Prevent further replication writes to the replica prefix with a bucket policy requiring SSE-KMS. 2) Pause replication pipeline until grants are fixed.
Zoe (infra): Pushing temp deny policy to replica bucket now. Policy snippet: `Deny PutObject if s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption != aws:kms`
Arun (db): For remediation we can perform a server-side copy within the replica account to apply SSE-KMS once we have right grants. But the copy actor must have kms:Encrypt on the external key.
Tasha (encops): Also need CloudTrail audit: who triggered replication writes? Check `AssumedRole: replication-agent@prod`.
Miguel (sre): CloudTrail shows `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/replication-agent/replicator` at 2026-04-02T11:02:10Z from 10.32.4.9.
Zoe (infra): Root cause: external HSM key policy omitted `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/replication-agent`. Adding grant isn't possible with HSM-managed keys in the same way; we need to update key policy in the replica account to trust the principal or use a KMS alias that maps correctly.
Tasha (encops): Security impact: moderate (snapshots contain PII), exposure likelihood low (no public), classification security-corrective.
Miguel (sre): Action items: - infra add cross-account trust for the replica IAM role in HSM key policy - pause replication until validated - add CI check: replication must assert SSE header on PutObject response.
Arun (db): I'll mark these snapshots `do-not-restore` and plan server-side copy after infra confirms grants. Tagging to include `incident=4765432100`.
Zoe (infra): Updated key policy and verified with `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/replica-hsm-key` showing new statement for the replication role.
kms-bot: KMS policy change recorded: key alias/replica-hsm-key policy updated by Zoe at 2026-04-02T11:20:00Z.
Miguel (sre): Unpaused replication in a test prefix only. Running scan across replica bucket for any other null-SSE objects.
Arun (db): Performed server-side copy for the 3 affected objects; they now report `ServerSideEncryption: aws:kms` and tags include `reencrypted_by=replica infra`. Restores unlocked.
Tasha (encops): Postmortem items: - include cross-account KMS trust checks in onboarding playbook - add replication canary that verifies SSE headers after role changes - add alert on CloudTrail for PutObject events with null ServerSideEncryption in replica account.
Miguel (sre): Logging runbook entry and will add detection to oncall.
Tasha (encops): Closing incident, filing follow-ups in tracker. Thanks all :thumbsup:
